channel.title: The Greenville Advocate - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Greenville Advocate (greenvilleadvocate.com)

item.title: Local teams move regions in AHSAA reclassification
item.description: New AHSAA reclassification reshapes Butler County teams, moving Georgiana, McKenzie, Greenville and Fort Dale to new regions under revamped public and private school classes.

item.title: Camellia show draws enthusiasts from across southeast
item.description: Third Annual Greenville Camellia Show fills LBW Community College with colorful blooms as Southeast growers compete and local entrants earn multiple category wins.

item.title: Blossom is ready to bloom
item.description: Sweet cat Blossom waits for a home at crowded Butler County Humane Society. Cats are $85, dogs $125, with spay or neuter and shots. Call or text Cory at (334) 368-8246.

item.title: This week in history: 1916
item.description: Greenville in 1916 saw a packed murder trial, a musical comedy at the opera house and claims that Atlantic air travel was already within reach.

item.title: Upcoming Butler County events
item.description: Presented by Georgiana Opry House For up-to-the minute information, visit our online Community Calendar at www.greenvilleadvocate.com. item.title: Historical society holds camellia care program
item.description: Storms thinned the crowd, but BCHGS’s Jan. 25 meeting at Beeland Park delivered hands-on camellia pruning tips and local history behind Greenville’s “Camellia City” name.

item.title: LBW releases fall honor lists
item.description: LBW Community College honored 244 students on its Fall 2025 President’s and Dean’s Lists, including several from Georgiana, Greenville and McKenzie.

item.title: The art of interviewing poorly
item.description: A humorously bad-interview guide morphs into real advice on handling nerves, preparation, and what to wear before a job interview you really want.

item.title: Growing roots for the community
item.description: Butler County Forestry Planning Committee’s Jan. 31 Tree Seedling Sale offers $2 trees and shrubs, supporting forestry workshops and a June youth camp.

item.title: Locals commended on UWA honors lists
item.description: Butler County students earn spots on UWA fall 2025 Dean's and President's Lists, recognized for GPAs above 3.25 with no grade below C.
